I've answered Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team. The seat count posted for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261. Ilse gave that figure in #north-team on 10/14.

I haven't confirmed 261 against the signed contract because it isn't among the files I can open for Dana. The 3/23 renewal digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 by Ilse (acting) and Thea Ramaswell, but it doesn't list a seat count. I told Dana to check with June or Ilse if the tracker needs the number confirmed against the signed copy.

Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, and Dana is on the North team, so no approval was needed.
